top_signals.title: Finland closes airspace, restricts maritime traffic near Russia over drone risk
top_signals.summary: Finland’s military said it closed a section of Finnish airspace and restricted maritime traffic off the country’s southern coast near the Russian border.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ionic Digital jumps 25% in Nasdaq debut after expanding Celsius bitcoin mining assets into AI infrastructure
top_signals.summary: Ionic Digital was formed from Celsius Mining’s assets and later took direct control of its sites from Hut 8.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
